---
name: Factual error or outdated statistic
about: Report a number, fact, or citation that is wrong or has gone stale
title: "[Error] "
labels: correction
---

**Where is it?**
Chapter and section, plus the table or figure number if it is in one
(for example: Chapter 14, "Industry Structure", Table 14.4).

**What does the book say?**
Quote the sentence or cell.

**What should it say?**
The corrected value or statement.

**Source**
A link to the authoritative source, ideally a government series (BEA, BLS,
Census, EIA, CMS, USDA) with the release date. Please note the vintage of
the data you are citing — the book's convention is explained in
[How to Use This Book](../../book/how-to-use.md).

**Is this an error or a vintage question?**
- [ ] The figure was never right
- [ ] The figure was right for its stated year but newer data is available
